crossRefs.note: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by…
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from…
They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach.…
When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of…
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.
translations.bsb: When he arrived, there was Eli, sitting on his chair beside the road and watching, because his heart trembled for the ark of God. When the man entered the city to give a report, the whole city cried out.
translations.kjv: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.
translations.asv: And when he came, lo, Eli was sitting upon his seat by the wayside watching; for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.
